precondition_sources.text: The external createGauge entry is permissionless.
A fake CL pool contract with code is supplied as the pool address for gauge creation.
The fake pool reports token0 = HYBR.
Each epoch the distributor transfers HYBR into the gauge before distribution, so the gauge holds non-zero HYBR at claim time.

intent_sources.text: A CL gauge may only be created for a pool address that is verified against the canonical CL factory.
CL fee claiming must forward only the exact fee amounts returned by the pool, mirroring the volatile gauge path, and must not sweep the gauge's balanceOf.
The protocol reward token must be rejected as a fee token for internal bribes on CL gauges, or forwarding of the protocol reward token must be blocked.
